"""Post-control development diagnosis; no tracker decisions or thresholds change."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from app.tracking.deepocsort import DEFAULT_MODEL, OSNetEmbedder


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


out = Path('.cache/consensus-boundary-features-v1')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
old = Path('data/tracking/bench/consensus_control_v1')
review = Path('docs/measurements/identity-consensus-control-boundary-review.json')
replay = Path('.cache/consensus-production-v2/report.json')
cases = []
for group in load(replay)['comparisons']:
    for b in group['boundaries']:
        cases.append(dict(b, scope='original_development', segment=group['segment'], verdict='not_adjudicated_here',
            predictions=str(Path('.cache/consensus-production-v2') / group['group'] / f"seg_{group['segment']:04d}.json"),
            video=str(Path('data/tracking/bench/daylight_117093/source') / f"seg_{group['segment']:04d}.mp4")))
for b in load(review)['records']:
    cases.append(dict(b, scope='closed_failed_control_now_development',
        predictions=str(old / 'day/predictions/consensus' / f"seg_{b['segment']:04d}.json"),
        video=str(old / 'day/source' / f"seg_{b['segment']:04d}.mp4")))
paths = {Path(__file__), Path(DEFAULT_MODEL), review, replay, Path('app/tracking/deepocsort.py')}
paths.update(Path(c[k]) for c in cases for k in ['predictions', 'video'])
hashes = {str(p): sha(p) for p in paths}
embedder = OSNetEmbedder(DEFAULT_MODEL)
reports = []
for i, c in enumerate(cases):
    samples = load(c['predictions'])['samples']
    obs = [(s, p) for s in samples for p in s['persons'] if p[0] in [c['raw_id'], c['new_id']]]
    before = [(s, p) for s, p in obs if s['order'] < c['first_order']][-12:]
    after = [(s, p) for s, p in obs if s['order'] >= c['first_order']][:12]
    assert len(before) >= 3 and len(after) >= 3
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(c['video'])
    vectors, rows, thumbnails = [], [], []
    for s, p in before + after:
        cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, s['frame_idx'])
        ok, frame = cap.read()
        assert ok
        vector = embedder.compute_embedding(frame, np.asarray([p[1:5]]))[0]
        vectors.append(vector)
        rows.append(dict(order=s['order'], frame_idx=s['frame_idx'], box=p[1:5],
            side='before' if s['order'] < c['first_order'] else 'after', embedding=vector.tolist()))
        x1, y1 = max(0, int(p[1])-100), max(0, int(p[2])-70)
        x2, y2 = min(frame.shape[1], int(p[3])+100), min(frame.shape[0], int(p[4])+70)
        thumbnail = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(frame[y1:y2, x1:x2], cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(thumbnail)
        draw.rectangle((p[1]-x1, p[2]-y1, p[3]-x1, p[4]-y1), outline='yellow', width=2)
        thumbnail.thumbnail((395, 285))
        thumbnails.append(thumbnail)
    cap.release()
    embeddings = np.asarray(vectors)
    distances = np.clip(1 - embeddings @ embeddings.T, 0, 2)
    n = len(before)
    selected = list(range(max(0,n-4), min(len(rows),n+4)))
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (1600, 640), 'white')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for pos, ix in enumerate(selected):
        x, y = pos % 4 * 400, pos // 4 * 320
        sheet.paste(thumbnails[ix], (x, y+28))
        draw.text((x+4,y+4), f"order {rows[ix]['order']} {rows[ix]['side']}", fill='black')
    sheet.save(out / f'case-{i}.jpg', quality=95)
    cross = distances[n-3:n, n:n+3]
    within_before = distances[n-3:n, n-3:n][np.triu_indices(3, 1)]
    within_after = distances[n:n+3, n:n+3][np.triu_indices(3, 1)]
    report = dict(case=c, rows=rows, cosine_distances=distances.tolist(),
        immediate_three=dict(cross_median=float(np.median(cross)), cross_min=float(cross.min()),
            cross_max=float(cross.max()), before_median=float(np.median(within_before)),
            after_median=float(np.median(within_after))))
    reports.append(report)
    (out / f'case-{i}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(i, c['segment'], c['raw_id'], c['verdict'], report['immediate_three'], flush=True)
assert hashes == {p: sha(p) for p in hashes}
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope=__doc__, hashes=hashes, device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
    reports=reports, limitations='General OSNet features; single-reviewer closed control labels. '
        'Seven boundaries only, no new control. No threshold chosen and no accuracy improvement claimed.'), indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

"""Compare a pinned public sports OSNet on all seven known development boundaries."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
import torch
from numpy._core.multiarray import scalar
from PIL import Image
from torchvision import transforms as T

from app.tracking.deepocsort import OSNetEmbedder


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


upstream = Path('.cache/upstream-gta-link-e4d5cc4')
checkpoint = upstream / 'sports_model.pth.tar-60'
assert sha(checkpoint) == '8d5b2fd8763db34c2aad69810466adf413f0426d9f8119d322227e0e639c5fbd'
prior_path = Path('.cache/consensus-boundary-features-v1/report.json')
prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
out = Path('.cache/sports-boundary-features-v1')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
paths = [Path(__file__), prior_path, checkpoint, upstream / 'osnet.py', upstream / 'LICENSE', upstream / 'REID-LICENSE']
paths += [Path(r['case']['video']) for r in prior['reports']]
hashes = {str(p): sha(p) for p in paths}
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reviewed_gta_osnet', upstream / 'osnet.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
safe = [(scalar, 'numpy.core.multiarray.scalar'), np.dtype, type(np.dtype('float32')), type(np.dtype('float64'))]
with torch.serialization.safe_globals(safe):
    payload = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
model = module.osnet_x1_0(num_classes=616, pretrained=False)
model.load_state_dict(payload['state_dict'], strict=True)
model = model.eval().cuda()
del payload
opencv = OSNetEmbedder.__new__(OSNetEmbedder)
opencv.model, opencv.device, opencv.path = model, 'cuda', str(checkpoint)
pil = T.Compose([T.Resize([256, 128]), T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(mean=[.485,.456,.406], std=[.229,.224,.225])])
reports = []
for i, old in enumerate(prior['reports']):
    case = old['case']
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(case['video'])
    variants = dict(sports_opencv=[], sports_pil=[])
    for row in old['rows']:
        cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, row['frame_idx'])
        ok, frame = cap.read()
        assert ok
        variants['sports_opencv'].append(opencv.compute_embedding(frame, np.asarray([row['box']]))[0].tolist())
        image = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).crop(tuple(row['box']))
        with torch.inference_mode():
            vector = torch.nn.functional.normalize(model(pil(image).unsqueeze(0).cuda()), dim=-1)[0].cpu().numpy()
        assert np.isfinite(vector).all()
        variants['sports_pil'].append(vector.tolist())
    cap.release()
    variants['general_opencv'] = [r['embedding'] for r in old['rows']]
    result = dict(case=case, source_rows=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k != 'embedding'} for r in old['rows']], variants={})
    k = sum(r['side'] == 'before' for r in old['rows'])
    for name, vectors in variants.items():
        embs = np.asarray(vectors)
        dist = np.clip(1-embs @ embs.T,0,2)
        windows = {}
        for n in [3,5,8,12]:
            before, after = dist[max(0,k-n):k,max(0,k-n):k], dist[k:k+n,k:k+n]
            between = dist[max(0,k-n):k,k:k+n]
            within = max(float(np.median(before[np.triu_indices(len(before),1)])),
                         float(np.median(after[np.triu_indices(len(after),1)])))
            windows[n] = dict(cross_median=float(np.median(between)), within_median_max=within,
                margin=float(np.median(between))-within)
        result['variants'][name] = dict(embeddings=vectors, cosine_distances=dist.tolist(), windows=windows)
    reports.append(result)
    (out / f'case-{i}.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(i, case['segment'],case['raw_id'],case['verdict'],
        {name: {n:round(v['margin'],4) for n,v in r['windows'].items()} for name,r in result['variants'].items()}, flush=True)
assert hashes == {p: sha(p) for p in hashes}
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope=__doc__, upstream_commit='e4d5cc4065ceb1ec3fa9dc7478455f13a8d7f9ca',
    hashes=hashes, reports=reports, limitations='Seven previously opened boundaries, diagnostic only. '
    'General model is OSNet-AIN; sports model is OSNet-X1 with 616 training identities. '
    'SportsMOT training provenance is reported by upstream README; no independently verified training overlap audit. '
    'OpenCV and official PIL preprocessing are separate arms. No production changes or new controls.'), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

"""CPU-only upstream connector sanity probe on partial source-derived fragments."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import torch


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


source = Path('.cache/upstream-gta-link-e4d5cc4')
features_path = Path('.cache/sports-boundary-features-v1/report.json')
features = json.loads(features_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
out = Path('.cache/gta-connector-boundary-probe-v1')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
paths = [Path(__file__), features_path, source / 'Tracklet.py', source / 'refine_tracklets.py', source / 'LICENSE']
hashes = {str(p): sha(p) for p in paths}
# Execute only the reviewed class and connector functions. Their bodies are
# unchanged. The upstream CLI, pickle loading, plotting and splitter imports
# are not needed for this bounded component probe.
namespace = dict(np=np, torch=torch)
exec(compile((source / 'Tracklet.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), str(source / 'Tracklet.py'), 'exec'), namespace)
tree = ast.parse((source / 'refine_tracklets.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
names = {'find_consecutive_segments', 'query_subtracks', 'get_spatial_constraints', 'get_distance_matrix',
         'get_distance', 'check_spatial_constraints', 'merge_tracklets'}
nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]
assert {n.name for n in nodes} == names
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), str(source / 'refine_tracklets.py'), 'exec'), namespace)
Tracklet = namespace['Tracklet']
rows = []
for i, case in enumerate(features['reports']):
    for name, values in case['variants'].items():
        tracklets = {}
        for tid, side in [(1, 'before'), (2, 'after')]:
            indices = [ix for ix, r in enumerate(case['source_rows']) if r['side'] == side]
            records = [case['source_rows'][ix] for ix in indices]
            boxes = [r['box'] for r in records]
            xywh = [[b[0], b[1], b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]] for b in boxes]
            tracklets[tid] = Tracklet(tid, [r['order'] for r in records], [1.] * len(records), xywh,
                feats=[values['embeddings'][ix] for ix in indices])
        counts = sum(len(t.times) for t in tracklets.values())
        with patch.object(torch.cuda, 'is_available', return_value=False):
            ranges = namespace['get_spatial_constraints'](tracklets, 1.0)
            distances = namespace['get_distance_matrix'](tracklets)
            between = float(distances[0,1])
            merged = namespace['merge_tracklets'](deepcopy(tracklets), {}, distances.copy(),
                seq_name=str(i), max_x_range=ranges[0], max_y_range=ranges[1], merge_dist_thres=.4)
        assert sum(len(t.times) for t in merged.values()) == counts
        rows.append(dict(case=i, segment=case['case']['segment'], raw_id=case['case']['raw_id'],
            original_verdict=case['case']['verdict'], variant=name, observations=counts,
            mean_cosine_distance=between, merged=len(merged)==1, source_observations_retained=True))
assert hashes == {p: sha(p) for p in hashes}
report = dict(scope=__doc__, upstream_commit='e4d5cc4065ceb1ec3fa9dc7478455f13a8d7f9ca',
    hashes=hashes, merge_dist_thres=.4, spatial_factor=1., device='CPU', rows=rows,
    limitations='Partial fragments: up to 12 observations per side, not complete tracklets. '
        'Full-sequence overlaps and long-history features can change the result. No splitter, '
        'no full GTA pipeline, no new control, no HOTA/IDF1. Scores are unused fixture placeholders. '
        'Frame indices use the existing 12.5fps sample order. Body of each selected upstream function unchanged.')
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))
